compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays an article from "Popular Science News" with the headline "Why NASA is going to vaporize one of its best spacecraft." The article is dated 4/7/17 and includes an image of the Cassini spacecraft. Below the image, there is a brief summary stating that Cassini's "grand finale" begins on April 23, and it will meet a very violent end for a good reason. A link to the full article on www.popsci.com is provided. The screen also features a navigation bar at the top with icons for notifications, battery status, and time, as well as a banner advertisement at the bottom.
